recommendation: Keep the external-repo audit commit. Any future update to the manufacturing batch extension, including possible R6 Medication.instance context alignment after FHIR-47622, should be handled in the FHIR Extension Pack with Pharmacy review rather than in this core reconciliation branch.
issue_request: FHIR-29576 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a placeholder for comments relevant to Medication.Batch, with examples such as first batch manufactured at a new facility, first batch with a new API source, new process, or new container closure. The resolution was to create a core extension for the attribute.
initial_application: No FHIR-29576-tagged commit was found in core or Extension Pack history. Historical core source did contain source/medication/structuredefinition-extension-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with the requested additionalInformation slice, Pharmacy minutes record that the extension was created and added to the build, and dd468d4f17 later removed the core extension file as part of moving extensions out of the R5 source.
additional_context: The current HL7/fhir checkout is R6 ballot source: Medication is active in source/fhir.ini and now uses Medication.instance after FHIR-47622. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout contains input/definitions/multiple/StructureDefinition-medication-manufacturingBatch.xml with the canonical medication-manufacturingBatch extension, Medication.batch/Substance context, and the requested additionalInformation string slice. Community evidence found a 2022 Zulip thread using that standard extension and additionalInformation slice.
reconciliation: No HL7/fhir source change was made. The requested extension content exists in the Extension Pack, and the old core extension file's absence from current HL7/fhir is consistent with the deliberate extension migration.

related_jiras.note: Later Applied/Persuasive Pharmacy issue renamed Medication.batch to Medication.instance in current core; it was reviewed only to interpret current context and was not decided here.
